Source: WO-2025-0095, section 
Work order WO-2025-0095: CN-TFD, oil pressure switch replacement
Work performed

Replaced engine oil pressure switch with new, zero-time switch P/N 83278, per AD 2013-11-11.

Removed switch P/N 83278 at 2,951.3 hours since installation.

Ground run: oil pressure indication normal, no leaks. Torque per maintenance manual. Wrench T-037.

Source: WO-2025-0095, section 
Work order WO-2025-0095: CN-TFD, oil pressure switch replacement
Request

Engine oil pressure switch at its limit.

Source: PROC-R7, section 3
Procedures manual, revision 7 (excerpt)
3 Life-limited and time-controlled parts

3.1 Tracking. Time-controlled parts are listed in the fleet register, sheet Time-controlled parts, with the airframe hours at installation. The hours used on a part are the airframe's current total time minus the airframe hours at installation.

3.2 Engine oil pressure switch. AD 2013-11-11 limits the engine oil pressure switch, P/N 83278, to 3,000 hours time-in-service on the airplanes within its applicability. Anfa applies the same 3,000-hour limit to every Cessna 172R and 172S it maintains, including those outside the directive's serial number ranges. Plan the replacement when a switch reaches 2,900 hours. Keep two switches in stock.

3.3 When the records disagree. If the fleet register and a work order or logbook give different hours for the same installation, use the lower airframe hours at installation until the quality manager has resolved the difference. Never use the figure that gives the part more time.
